# Compute losses (negative log likelihood summed over tokens)
    loss_with_result = -np.sum(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    loss_call_only = -np.sum(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    loss_no_call = -np.sum(logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Improvement over no call
    margin = loss_no_call - loss_with_result

    # Keep if margin >= tau and result helps over call-only
